scope: Every odd prime p, even 2 <= c < p, odd 1 <= d < p, r >= 2, s > r, n = c*p^r + d; all primitive characteristic-zero p^s phases. Original P and H squarefree; original algebraic-square CD kernel nonzero at every P root.
added_range_relative_to_supplied_predece: c >= 4 and odd d >= 3. General d = 1 and c = 2 all odd tails are inherited, not newly credited.
r2_leading_obstruction: R_c(-alpha) = 0 mod p; alpha = (d-1)!! / d!!; exactly 2p affected X roots counted with multiplicity.
r2_lift: At p >= 5, affected roots have derivative value K + delta + m + 1 unless p divides 2d+1; then p=2d+1>=7 and value K + delta + m + 2. Both normalized units are nonzero.
p3_boundary: Inherited c=2,d=1 only; r=2 central derivative value 76/3. New correction argument not applied.
exclusions: arbitrary n or base-p digit strings
